story: In the diverse world of birds, the Pied Kingfisher (Ceryle rudis) stands out. This species, part of the Alcedinidae family, is a resident of Near rivers; ponds; lakes; seashores; freshwater wetlands; and coastal waters up to 2500 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Pied Kingfisher is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Pied Kingfisher and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
